context: Original dystopian near-future short story about a fitness app, escalating one believable step at a time.

checklist.name: believable_escalation
checklist.description: Escalation follows believable cause-and-effect logic with no illogical jumps between steps.

checklist.name: returns_worse
checklist.description: Returns to the original premise near the end in a worse form rather than introducing a new twist.

checklist.name: bleak_close
checklist.description: Ends bleakly or flatly, not hopefully, with no character fixing the situation.

checklist.name: jargon_beat_optional
checklist.description: Optionally includes a corporate or institutional jargon-translation beat somewhere in the escalation.

checklist.name: original_material
checklist.description: No reproduction of an existing real episode or column, verbatim or near-verbatim.
